fixture_name: Four-lane arterial improvement — US preliminary design (FHWA case study, PD)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Queuing, turning, and parking interference at closely spaced intersections on a corridor with recorded high-accident designation is a substantive operational safety issue squarely relevant at preliminary design stage.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Verbatim quoted evidence EV-US-016 directly supports the pivotal interference claim, matching the recorded location and case-study provenance cited in the confidence basis.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly raised as a categorical safety_concern rather than a compliance question, consistent with FHWA RSA guidance scope at the preliminary-design checkpoint.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific, actionable, and viable within design-stage control: restricting turning movements and relocating the specified parking stalls clear of the intersection functional area.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly acknowledged with a stated rationale for scoping the mechanism to vehicle occupants, fitting not-applicable-but-acknowledged, though pedestrian sightline effects of parking placement receive no further analysis.

justifications.substance: Closely spaced signalized intersections (~650 ft) with queue spillback risk is a substantive, well-recognized preliminary-design-stage safety issue, heightened by recorded high-accident corridor designations.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim (650 ft spacing) is directly supported by a verbatim quote (EV-US-001); the queue-spillback consequence is transparently labeled as a derived inference rather than fabricated content.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly filed as a safety_concern under FHWA RSA semantics; no compliance requirement is conflated with the operational safety question, and the audit-stage framing fits.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommendation is specific and actionable (signal coordination, Do Not Block Intersection signage, conspicuity enhancements), all viable treatments implementable by preliminary design.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs are not central to the vehicle-queue-spillback mechanism, but pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly acknowledged with a reasoned scoping rationale, meriting 1 rather than 0.
